games.name: MINERALS: Deep Core Mining
games.summary: Mine the vast underground and collect ores and gemstones—collect! collect! collect like crazy! “MINERALS: Deep Core Mining” is an over-the-top mining game with roguelite elements. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your abilities and take on an endless underground that changes with every run!

A Short & Simple Pixel Love Story
games.summary: This linear visual novel tells the story of protagonist Lance, a 25-year-old male, who is dating in these modern times.

games.name: Academy: Become a Hero
games.summary:
Challenge time and gravity in an epic race for glory!

Academy: Become a Hero is an exciting 2.5D platformer where you must complete challenging circuits before the countdown ends. Master unique abilities, overcome the course, and strive to become the next hero humanity needs.

games.name: Alien Bloom
games.summary: Battle for control of the planet in this multiplayer strategy card game.

games.name: AquaDesk
games.summary: AquaDesk is a relaxing aquarium simulation that turns your desktop into a living home for tropical fish. Feed, care for, breed, and discover unique fish through genetics and unlock new features as your calm desktop aquarium grows.

games.name: Calculator - Desktop Mate Widgets Kagamine Len DLC
Calculator - Desktop Mate Widgets Kagamine Rin DLC
Calculator - Desktop Mate Widgets Megurine Luka DLC
Da Bomb!
games.summary: Discover the revival of Minesweeper. Da Bomb! twists the classic concept into an explosive 3D puzzle. Clear the grid across the surface of a cube, and test your reflexes in the innovative and addictive Time Attack mode. Every second counts!

games.name: Escape War
games.summary: You are the last person to evacuate a city that is being bombed. Survive and escape.

games.name: G.O.D. Global Orbital Defense
games.summary: Take control of the G.O.D. system, the U.P.A.’s tactical satellite. Orbiting in silence above Vel’Aris, your mission is to protect the planet from every threat. Manage orbital fire. But remember: G.O.D. sees everything... even what you wish remained buried.

games.name: How Many Calories Are In A Muffin?
games.summary: A short story about a difficult day at work and a painful breakup that lingers; about depression, anxiety, and how they can lead to eating disorders. Do you know how many calories are in a muffin? Are you ready for what the answer implies?

games.name: Lamp Clicker
games.summary: Lamp Clicker is a simple and addictive incremental / idle clicker game where your goal is to build your own… lamp empire.

games.name: Limbot
games.summary:
Welcome to Limbot, the ultimate physics-based city stomping experience where up to 4 players must attempt to pilot a person dressed as a giant cardboard robot! 

Embrace the chaos in a paper-craft metropolis designed to be crushed, smashed, and destroyed!

Intuitive controls make moving limbs simple and accessible to players of all ages and abilities. All you need to do is figure out how to work together... good luck with that! Oh, one more thing, if the robot trips, it's definitely your teammate’s fault!

games.name: Old Coin Pusher Gaiden
games.summary: A new evolution of Old Coin Pusher Friends: a coin‑pusher RPG where you train your samurai, prepare Action Spheres, and explore deep caves filled with enemies, treasures, and events. Shoot Coins to earn rewards. Up to four players can battle The formidable in Raid mode.

games.name: Path of Idle: Old Gods Rising
Pro Jank Footy
games.summary:
Pro Jank Footy is an absurd and over-the-top arcade sports game.

Score a goal? Your opponent picks a game-changing power-up.

Hinder your opponents, increase your footy abilities with powers that give your team strong legs, or turn the gameplay completely on its head by transforming everyone into footballs - the choice is yours!

Outplay, out-kick, and out-jank your mates in local multiplayer. Or, if you’re shy, conquer single-player season mode.

games.name: Quantum Hell
games.summary: Take on the role of a journalist trapped in a ruthless quantum universe where you'll need a diverse arsenal and the manipulation of quantum physics to survive and progress. Quick thinking, speed, and precision will be essential to surviving in this retro style physics FPS

games.name: Renz Village Adventure
games.summary: Manage a growing fantasy village where heroes fight monsters, explore dungeons, level up, and bring home treasure to expand your town.

games.name: Security 51
games.summary:
Security 51 is an atmospheric horror security guard simulator inspired by Papers, Please, and SCP paranoia. 

You're on duty in the underground bunker of Area 51, where the most dangerous part begins at the elevator: the shaft descends for miles down to unknown levels. Whether it's laboratories, anomalies, inhumane experiments, or something alien - you're not supposed to know. 

Your task is simple: let in those who have access and stop those who don't... even if everything looks "right" on the surface.

games.name: Sort Them Ducks
games.summary: Sort Them Ducks is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,000 unique rubber ducks onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy duck store into a perfectly organized collection at your own pace.

games.name: Storehand
games.summary: Storehand is a cozy stocking game about tidying shelves, organizing thousands of items, and shaping your own store layout. Map custom aisles, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy a relaxing free‑placement mode as you build your perfect shop.

games.name: Teddy's Horde
games.summary: A top-down arena survival brawler. Pick a bear, drop into the arena, and hold out against escalating waves of wardens. Alone or with your friends in local coop.

games.name: Theme Song EP - THEIR SECRET HUMS
Tidy Mart
games.summary: Tidy Mart is a cozy organizing game where you arrange hundreds of products across different stores, from a small corner shop to a sprawling supermarket. No time limits. No rushing customers. Sit back, relax, and enjoy.

games.name: Vaulted Valor
games.summary:
Trapped in an underground vault designed to protect humanity, you discover that survival comes at a cost. 

In Vaulted Valor, a narrative-driven post-apocalyptic RPG, every choice matters as you navigate a world of intrigue, sabotage, and hidden agendas. 

Will you unite the vault’s inhabitants to confront its dark truths, or will the fractures within tear it apart?

games.name: 30 Days On Ship: Castaway – The First Days
Aquasushi Cat
games.summary: Make the aquariums nervous — in an incremental game that grows bigger with every dive. Set up your own kitchen and take on the world in Arcade Mode to claim the crown. It won't always be easy. But it's worth it.

games.name: Archomni 2: Mondus Maxima
games.summary: Archomni Evolved is here. Build your six-card deck, master the grid, outduel relentless opponents in fast, tactical card combat. Win by draining their HP or completing all 8 winning line formations. Cards are in your hand. The grid is your battlefield. This is Archomni — Evolved.

games.name: Aussie Rules Legend
games.summary: Build your own Australian Rules Football legend in a retro-inspired career and management game. Play, coach and manage your club across decades of football with deep career modes, historical records, custom leagues and up to four-player local multiplayer.

games.name: Brutal Bible Bloodbaths - AI Assisted Edition
Cairn - On the Trail: Deep Water
games.summary:
On the Trail is a series of free DLCs for the award winning survival climbing game Cairn. Set out on the ascent of a lifetime with pro-climber Aava: climb anywhere, plan your route carefully, and manage your resources to survive the unforgiving ascent of Mount Kami.

On the Trail brings climbers to new climbing locations and challenges. Find your route freely in the new spots, solve fresh climbing problems and explore iconic places as you follow the trail of a legendary climber.

On the Trail: Deep Water, the first of the series, brings you 3 new climbing spots, and introduces water soloing: you can now climb over water, without the consequences when falling!

games.name: Card Reversi
games.summary: Place, flip, and rule the board. A 3×3 territory card battle. Collect 100+ cards, master their special abilities, and claim victory. Features a 6-chapter story plus a hidden chapter, a HARD mode, CPU matches, and online play (random/ranked/friend). Switch between 2D and 3D boards.

games.name: Choppa: Rescue Rivals
games.summary: Take to the skies in Choppa: Rescue Rivals! Pilot daring rescue missions in a Saturday-morning-anime story mode packed with high-stakes action, colorful characters, and a globe-trotting adventure. Save lives, outfly rivals, and become a legendary ace pilot! Choppa: Rescue Rivals is a modern-but-retro reimagining of the arcade-style action games made famous by 1980s classics like Choplifter, with a touch of Nintendo mixed in. Like many, we share a deep nostalgia for the vibrant world of the ‘80s and ‘90s media: Arcade games, toys, cartoons and anime that defined our childhoods. Driven by this passion, we set out to create a game that brings those cherished memories to life. A Nostalgic "Saturday Morning Anime" Storyline Step into the cockpit with Rick, a legendary rescue chopper pilot coaxed out of retirement for one last, crucial mission on a disaster-ravaged oil rig. With his rescue pilot license freshly reinstated, Rick is thrust into an unexpected scuffle with Burdock, his former wingman turned adversary, uncovering a sinister plot led by the malevolent A.C.R corporation. As the stakes soar higher, Rick and his comrades from the Thunderbolt Rescue Foundation must outwit and outmaneuver their foes to thwart Burdock's dark ambitions. Dynamic Globetrotting Gameplay Choppa: Rescue Rivals offers a unique blend of chaotic gameplay, compelling storytelling, and cooperative rivalry. Prepare for an unforgettable ride to the skies where luck, strategy and skill will determine the true heroes. Gather your team and don't forget: It's time to GET TO THE CHOPPA!

games.name: Creepshow
games.summary:
In collaboration with AMC and Creepshow production company Cartel Entertainment, DreadXP's game will bring the hit series to an interactive format in 2024 across multiple platforms, featuring the twisted talents of several renowned independent video game developers.

DreadXP's Creepshow video game will retain the iconic franchise's anthology horror format, consisting of multiple self-contained horror stories that cross gameplay genres and tone. Several independent developers popular in the horror development scene are contributing to Creepshow, including DarkStone Digital (The Mortuary Assistant).

games.name: Crownhold (Meridian Studios)
games.summary: Crownhold is a cozy storybook tower defense. Line winding roads with archers, mages, artillery and barracks, upgrade them into 12 mighty specializations, lead a hero and rain meteors on the goblin horde across 21 hand-painted levels — then hold on in Endless mode.

games.name: Dagger Directive
games.summary: Dagger Directive is a tactical FPS that allows you to approach each mission in your own way. Select equipment, decide the time of day, then move methodically to complete your mission. Enjoy the modern mechanics and old school graphics as you fight across a variety of missions and environments.

games.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
games.summary:
In the 1980s, Defender of the Crown helped define a new kind of cinematic strategy game. Now it returns, rebuilt for modern platforms and remastered with an entirely new way to play.

Conquer territories, raise armies, storm castles, and shift the balance of power. It's the Defender of the Crown you remember - just sharper, cleaner, and built for today.

games.name: Don't Blush
games.summary: An escape room unveils the Inner Realm. Don't Blush: An emotional FMV mystery game. Unravel the secrets of six mysterious women.

games.name: Dream House Cleaning
games.summary: Bring forgotten places back to life in a cozy cleaning and restoration game! Clean dirt and trash, repair damaged areas, decorate interiors with furniture, and enjoy a relaxing experience at your own pace.

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary:
Shatter the shackles of time as you jump, swing, and slash through a fantastic world in this love letter to classic 3D action platformers. Zirian, accompanied by his mechanical Cuckoo, must save his sister from a mysterious Clock Tower that has plunged the land into eternal night.

Explore stunning realms shaped by the Master Clockmakers, each filled with mystery, magic, breathtaking vistas, and endearing characters. Navigate ethereal forests, underwater realms, sunlit dunes and cloudy heights - the world of Duskfade is alive and teems with secrets for you to uncover.

Master a seamless blend of dynamic platforming and fast-paced combat. Jump, dash, grapple, and glide your way through thrilling challenges that rekindle the magic of classic action platformer favourites.

games.name: Flux Grid
games.summary: Route beams of light through a neon grid. Place mirrors, activate relays, split colors, and warp through portals across 175 hand-crafted puzzles in 5 seasons of escalating complexity. Think fast. Think angular.

games.name: Future Knight
games.summary:
Experience the ultimate LCD-style action on Nintendo Switch™!

Future Knight is a 2D action shoot ’em up that blends the nostalgia of LCD handheld games with the brutality of modern combat. Imagine your old portable gaming device brought to life, complete with a bizarre story, frantic battles, and a unique visual style inspired by classic electronic games.

8 HOURS UNTIL THE END OF THE WORLD

It’s May 23, 1993. The Lady of the Past, leader of the pyramid cult “Present,” has just washed her underwear and, in the process, erased the minds of all humanity. Only you—a robot built over the course of 30 years from the remains of a 1990s soap opera actor—can stop her. But you’re not alone. You have Two More, an inexplicably powerful, sentient benign tumor living inside you.

Your mission is to travel back in time exactly eight hours before the apocalypse. Each level (Biome) represents one hour in the Lady’s schedule before she wipes out everyone’s memories. You’ll need to sabotage her entire day—from a stroll through the park to a meal at an all-you-can-eat buffet. The clock is ticking, Future Knight. Can you save the future before it becomes the past?

games.name: Game Shop Panic
games.summary: No magic, no skills, no cooldowns. The only things that can clean up this messy store are your own two hands. Pick up retro game cartridges spanning three generations—8-bit, 16-bit, and 32-bit—stacked high on the floor, one by one, and place them manually onto the shelves of the correct genre.

games.name: Hell Let Loose: Vietnam
games.summary:
Enter the explosive conflict of the Vietnam War and fight your way through some of the fiercest clashes in modern history. 

Join the battle raging across an extreme landscape of vast mountain gorges and thick jungle, where the North Vietnamese Armies clash with the military strength of the US Armed Forces. Build tunnels, fly helicopters, drive patrol boats, use historically accurate weapons and work with your team to achieve victory.

Take the battle to the enemy across 6 large-scale maps that authentically recreate real world locations and dramatic terrain. Play as either the North Vietnamese Army or US Armed Forces and choose from one of 19 specialised roles within a 50-strong team made up of multiple squads. Join or lead infantry, recon, armour, mortar squads and helicopter units, using communication and teamwork with your fellow players to identify objectives and ruthlessly exploit your opponent’s weaknesses.

Follow the chain of command and work together as a team to meet your objectives and achieve victory.

games.name: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator Demo
Kingdoms vs Zombies
games.summary: Kingdoms vs Zombies is a blend of strategy, tower defense, and roguelike gameplay, where you must defend your kingdom against endless hordes of the undead.

games.name: Low-Budget Repairs
games.summary:
"There have been other games about spiders, but never one that so thoroughly celebrates the beauty and deadly elegance of their work." - jayisgames.com

Arachnophilia was a ground breaking online game we released in 2008. It has been one of our most successful games to date, and we're very excited to finally make it available on the iPhone and iPod Touch!

Arachnophilia is an arcade-style simulation of a night in the life of a spider. Your goal is to survive for as long as possible by building a web to trap and devour the hapless insects who blunder into it. How long can you survive, and how many different insects will you meet along the way? Can you become a legend among spiders and capture the bat? Compare your score on the global leaderboards or against your Facebook friends, and share it through Twitter, Facebook, or email.

But it's not all about survival - along with helpful gameplay tips, you're also treated to an array of interesting facts about spiders and the other creatures you encounter. And for a more relaxed experience you can indulge in "Art Mode", where you have unlimited webbing and an undisturbed canvas.

Arachnophilia is also available for the iPad.

games.name: Museum Girls Fleet Maneuvers: The Dockhand
Open The Gate: Just A Little
Orchid and Thyme
games.summary: Battle monsters and solve a mystery in this action-adventure game set in a colorful world!

games.name: Pixel Lens: Real-time Pixel Art Filter
Plungeez
games.summary:
Explore the underground labyrinth of a historic city’s sewers and uncover secrets in an interconnected world.

Plungeez is an exploration-focused puzzle-adventure that puts your mind to the test. Dive deep into a complex underground sewer system in the historic city of Salvador, Brazil, where progress isn’t measured by brute force, but by perception and logic.

Run, push, activate, and explore. Like a Metroidvania, Plungeez’s map is vast and full of hidden connections that require you to go back and forth to solve the central mysteries. With no combat distractions, you can fully focus on the mechanics of each puzzle and the unique atmosphere of this pixel-art world.

games.name: Purr in Bloom
games.summary: A cozy logic puzzle about finding hidden cats among blooming gardens. Follow simple clues, mark impossible spots, and discover every mischievous kitty!

games.name: Scratch the Ticket
games.summary: Scratch the Ticket is a first‑person incremental gambling sim where every ticket is a test of nerves. Print tickets, scratch cells, and decide: cash out now or risk it all. The outcome depends only on your choice.

games.name: SHKSHK
games.summary: Cut through dense fields of weeds, collect valuable resources, and turn small upgrades into explosive growth. Improve your equipment, automate harvesting, face changing weather, ascend for permanent power, and complete the upgrade tree to reach the final garden.

games.name: SimRail - The Railway Simulator: Łódź North Region
Skatesterre
games.summary:
Skatesterre is a fast-paced arcade skateboarding game inspired by the golden era of classic skate titles.

Link together huge combos, land stylish tricks, and shred through levels designed for speed, flow, and creativity.

Ride as Sterre Meijer a.k.a. Surfsterre, Dutch skateboarder and rising figure in the global skate scene, and carve your way through streets, parks, and urban playgrounds packed with rails, ramps, and hidden lines.

Complete missions, chase high scores, and unlock new fashion pieces as you progress - building your own unique skate style along the way.

games.name: Spear Of The Sky Supporter Edition
The Corrupted
games.summary: The Corrupted is a high-octane sci-fi PVE shooter defined by satisfying progression and intense boss encounters. Plunge into battlefields consumed by the Anomaly, fighting through relentless swarms, elite hunters, and colossal bosses.

games.name: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest Demo
The Legend of Mala Tokmachka
games.summary: Build, expand, and arm a towering 2D fortress to withstand endless waves of ground and air attacks. Set in a nameless frontier village where a siege has lasted so long it became a legend, "The Legend of Mala Tokmachka" turns survival into myth.

games.name: Train Sim World® 6: Schnellfahrstrecke Nürnberg - Ingolstadt Route Add-On
Wild Blue Skies
games.summary:
Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey! 

Wild Blue Skies is an exciting and modern take on the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s.

Soar over oceans, desert ridges, and perilous caves, battling waves of enemies and pushing back Grimclaw’s forces. With the help of allies, you’ll fight to restore peace while experiencing the thrill of classic arcade flight-combat!

Easy-to-learn controls make Wild Blue Skies accessible for newcomers and genre veterans alike, while the game’s stunning visuals immerse you in a hand-crafted, anime-style universe. With its compelling gameplay loop, branching paths, and thrilling missions, every flight is an adventure! 

Key Features: 

* Experience all the classic on-rails shooter action with new and modernized controls
* Discover a rich and colorful world with stunning vistas at every turn
* Fly through an action-packed campaign alongside a stalwart squad of allies 
* Take on exciting boss battles and dogfights against a mysterious rival squad
* Discover secret paths and missions on your quest to take down the evil Baron 
* Become an ace pilot and master every mission through a simple and challenging score system

games.name: Bear With Me: The Pizza Chronicles (Prequel)
Eerie Night - Escape from the Funfair - Collector's Edition
I Was a Failed Day Trader Who Lost Everything, But After Being Reincarnated in Another World, My Textbook Technical Analysis Actually Works and Now I'm the Richest Man in the Kingdom!?
Kiss And Cry：我的女友脑子有问题
Lootbound
games.summary: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

games.name: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor
games.summary:
Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Continue Enzo's story across two new chapters, featuring fresh environments, weapons, vehicles, and Charms. In new DLC content for Free Ride mode, team up with Salieri to earn big by taking on a new set of exclusive jobs and extreme challenges, and discover new collectibles and hidden locations as you explore.

games.name: Static Dread: The Submarine - Digital Art Collection
Static Dread: The Submarine - Original Soundtrack
Static Dread: The Submarine - Supporter Pack
Typing With Ghostie - A Happy Little Ghost
Typing With Ghostie - Ducky Ducky Ducky
Army of Tentacles: (Not) A Cthulhu Dating Sim 10th Anniversary Edition
I Want to Play the Villain! Demo
Rag Doll - Fun Fighting with Physics
The Lantern of the Laughless Saint
The World Well: Blood of Caro
ARC Raiders - The Tick Hunter Set
Darkest Dungeon: The Fire's Edge
games.summary:
“...we have each of us in the dustiest cellars of our minds a counter at which we strive to repay the debts of the past with the debased currency of the present.” - Gene Wolfe

Two more wayward souls wander the Old Road. The Duelist and Runaway, debuted in Darkest Dungeon II, bring their unique abilities to bear against horrors that lurk beneath the manor.
Patterned in burns, draped in tatters and wielding a crude poker, the vagrant Runaway favours fire and stealth when pressed to fight.
By contrast, the Duelist stands severe, her ornate capelet conspicuously pierced above the breast. No challenger has yet to hold quarter against her bitter edge.


Features:

    Two new hero classes: the Duelist and the Runaway
    Set the dungeon alight with Runaway’s new combat mechanic: Burn!
    New Trinket Mechanics such as Trigger Uses, Quest Charges and Progressive Trinkets
    3 new Hamlet Districts: Academie Duello, Craftworks, and Archaeological Base Camp


The Runaway is a position-flexible damage dealer utilizing a unique Burn damage type with high synergy for teams that like to utilize Stuns and Pull/Knockback/Shuffle effects.

The Duelist is a complex damage dealer that dances between the party’s ranks, able to freely maintain Riposte while alternating between her two combat stances, Defensive and Aggressive. Proper planning of the Duelist’s future turns is key to mastering her playstyle and maximizing her potential!

Fans of both games will delight in this re-visioning of these two new iconic heroes for Darkest Dungeon.

games.name: TFC2: The Fertile Crescent 2 - Collapse of The Bronze Age
The Sinking City 2
games.summary:
The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension. 

* Immerse yourself in a distinct atmosphere of cosmic horror and twisted designs drawn from the dark wellsprings of HP Lovecraft's macabre imagination. 
* Explore and survive the city of Arkham, a sprawling labyrinth of flooded alleys and decrepit mansions where eldritch horrors lurk just out of sight. 
* Use an arsenal of weapons to fight off Deep Ones, Mi-gos, occult zealots, and other iconic monsters from the source material as well as new and unique creatures that expand the Cthulhu Mythos. 
* Experience the classic survival horror formula at its finest, complete with inventory management, optional puzzles, and backtracking to newly unlocked areas and hidden treasures. 
* Use environmental storytelling and scattered clues to solve side mysteries that unlock new outcomes and gameplay bonuses.  
* Thanks to Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City 2 delivers next-gen visuals with Lumen global illumination, photorealistic Nanite geometry, life-like Metahuman-powered characters, and much more.

games.name: Watch Party: Watch the web together
宠物街金鱼姬 Pet Street Story
Legend of Shawy Cat: Mafia Prepack
The Walks We Used To Take
Bone to Pick / ボーン・トゥ・ピック 〜骨から始まる事件簿〜
Can Your Otaku Cabinet Grow a Beautiful Girl?
Contraband: Edge of the Fold Soundtrack
Gallipoli
games.summary:
What began on mainland Europe, was never likely to end there... Prepare for relentless WW1 beach landings and desert warfare across the Middle Eastern Front in Gallipoli!

Faced with the deadlocked trenches of the Western Front, the Triple Entente looked for new pathways to victory. What was thought to be a quick expeditionary campaign to remove a German ally from the war, ended up in a disastrous four-year campaign: the Ottoman Empire wasn’t going down without a fight.

Gallipoli marks the fourth entry in the WW1 Game Series, further broadening its authentic and realistic FPS combat experience to give you the deepest dive into the Middle Eastern Front of World War 1 yet.

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: how to kill a fly [ H2KAF ]
KOTAMON: My Sis Found A Super-Rare Card In Her Cereal Box, So I Became A Garbage Man To Find The Entire Collection And Earn $1,000,000
Mexican Ninja
games.summary: Become the Mexican Ninja and fight to take back Nuevo Tokyo, where Narcos and Yakuzas have fused into the ruthless Narkuzas. Master slick combos, unleash outrageous Mexican Jutsus and craft deadly builds in this fast, chaotic 2.5D roguelike beat ’em up.

games.name: Mortal Shell II
games.summary: Their Flesh Is Your Weapon. Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world.

games.name: Over the Top: WWI - US Expeditionary Forces
Puppergeist
games.summary:
Doggie Underworld: A Rhythmic Journey

Play as Claire, a witch who journeys into the mysterious Doggie Underworld with one simple goal: Finding her lost Pup!

As you travel through Doggie Underworld, you'll encounter countless souls, each with a story to tell. Share moments with them, play together, and listen to their heartfelt tales. Use your sense of rhythm to lift their spirits and ease their troubles, bringing you one beat closer to reuniting with your own lost Pup.

The Heart of the Game

As a visual novel with rhythm mechanics, the story moves forward as you succeed in rhythm challenges. Alongside her new demon friend, Lunne, Claire learns to deepen her connection with doggie spirits, uncovering stories of friendship, love, and loss.  Every rhythm challenge is unique, along with remixes and bonus features.

games.name: Metal Gear Solid Collection Vol. 2
searchAs: Metal Gear Solid Master Collection Vol.2

games.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
games.summary:
Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, play as Sophia, a fierce young plunderer, on the run but determined to uncover the secrets of her past. Dive into an original story blending combat, myth and fate with a brand new take in the universe of A Plague Tale.

Sophia’s journey leads to the Minotaur' Island, where she faces deadly trials, navigates treacherous trails, solves puzzles, all while fighting and staying one step ahead of the army chasing her. But the true challenge awaits, as the terrifying creature hidden behind the myth will soon resonate with her...

Every step is a risk. Every pause, a potential end. You can’t stop, only hide, outsmart, and push forward. Can you survive each trial and every step or will you join those who never came back?

games.name: Star Wars Zero Company
games.summary: Recruit an unconventional team of operatives and deploy them on missions unlike any other in the galaxy far, far away in Star Wars Zero Company!

games.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
games.summary:
Bringing together a talented team of developers, including members of the core team behind one of the most acclaimed games of all time - The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt along with its expansions, Rebel Wolves’ first title is a dark fantasy narrative sandbox, AAA action-RPG set in medieval Europe.

This brand-new IP is aimed at mature audiences and is powered by Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice. With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.

Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.

Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: CONTROL Resonant
games.summary:
With Control, we leaped into the unknown. We wanted to create something new. Something different and unexpected. A world like no other. 

With Control 2, we'll take another leap into the unknown. It'll be an unexpected journey.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary: SILENT HILL: Townfall, a co-production with Annapurna Interactive (Stray) and multiple BAFTA award winning No Code Studios (Stories Untold, Observation).
